Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def color_tree(A,wall,bg):
 W=set(map(tuple,np.argwhere(A==wall)))
 deg={p:0 for p in W}
 for r,c in W:
  deg[r,c]=sum((r+dr,c+dc) in W for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)])
 q=deque([p for p,d in deg.items() if d<=1]); core=set(W)
 while q:
  p=q.popleft()
  if p not in core:continue
  core.remove(p);r,c=p
  for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
   z=(r+dr,c+dc)
   if z in core:
    deg[z]-=1
    if deg[z]==1:q.append(z)
 # tree components; assign touching non-bg colors
 O=A.copy(); trees=W-core
 ll,nn=label(np.array([[ (r,c) in trees for c in range(A.shape[1])] for r in range(A.shape[0])]))
 for k in range(1,nn+1):
  pts=np.argwhere(ll==k); adj=set()
  for r,c in pts:
   for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
    rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
    if 0<=rr<A.shape[0] and 0<=cc<A.shape[1] and A[rr,cc] not in (wall,bg):adj.add(int(A[rr,cc]))
  if len(adj)==1:
   for r,c in pts:O[r,c]=adj.pop() if False else O[r,c] # ignore
   col=list({int(A[rr,cc]) for r,c in pts for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)] for rr,cc in [(r+dr,c+dc)] if 0<=rr<A.shape[0] and 0<=cc<A.shape[1] and A[rr,cc] not in (wall,bg)})[0]
   for r,c in pts:O[r,c]=col
  else: print('tree conflict',k,len(pts),adj)
 return O,core
